listing.tagline: A DeLM implementation built on Claude Code Kanban
listing.description: A DeLM implementation built on Claude Code Kanban. A supervisor and its workers run as Claude Code sessions on the Kanban board, share a task queue and a log of findings, and the app shows each swarm's tasks, claims and published changes. /swarm start refuses when the Kanban CLI does not run.

screenshots.alt: The Swarm timeline: three workers' claimed tasks over one hour, with findings, publications, applies, lost claims, a released task and a stopped worker, and the event list under it
screenshots.title: Timeline
screenshots.caption: Each worker's claims, findings and publications over time, and every event under it.

screenshots.alt: Swarm in the hub: the supervisor and two workers grouped in the Kanban sidebar, the task cards with the owner of each, and the Swarm timeline in a pane beside the board
screenshots.title: On the board
screenshots.caption: The supervisor and its workers sit in one group in the Kanban sidebar, and each card names the worker that claimed it.

screenshots.alt: The Swarm summary: the goal, the wall time, the outcome and delivered files, the request and its revision, the three workers and the items that need a look
screenshots.title: Summary
screenshots.caption: The goal, the outcome and the delivered files, the workers, and the items that need a look from you.

screenshots.alt: The Swarm changes view: who applied whose work, the files each worker touched, and the publications
screenshots.title: Changes
screenshots.caption: Who applied whose work, the files each worker touched, and what each one published.
